sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Active KP workflow frontier for dashboard-backed semantic animation system work.
Roadmap selects SemanticObject capability loading as one of the next loop choices after hosted/export closeout.
Semantic runtime thread names capability loading as an active next choice.
Hosted/export closeout recommends registry-backed capability loading before hardcoded encoder dependencies.

allowedWork: Only work on approved KP SemanticObject capability loading slices.
Keep work tied to semantic capability package metadata, tutorial dependency planning, export capability closure, dashboard/API catalog rows, and project docs.
Use metadata-first package manifests and deterministic fixtures before any dynamic loader.
disallowedWork: Do not implement GIF, MP4, or WebM encoders in this loop.
Do not implement full CAS behavior or broad symbolic algebra.
Do not pursue broad Theseus planner infrastructure unless it directly blocks this KP run contract.
Do not broaden into graph runtime unification beyond package metadata needed by graph capabilities.
goal: Turn sample-specific capability advertisements into registry-backed SemanticObject capability packages for tutorial cards, exports, dashboards, and future generated tutorials.
stopConditions: Stop when verification fails and needs product or architecture judgment.
Stop when the approved slice list is exhausted.
Stop before adding dynamic runtime package loading if metadata-first contracts are not stable.
